rationale: Kept safe nominal structure but made steady-state feedforward adaptive with faster settled-data gain estimator and gain-scheduled PI. Kest init 1.15, range [0.35,1.6], update rate ~55s only when settled (|yf-yavg|<0.02, y in [0.22,0.72], uavg>0.12, t>60s) so nominal cold-start stays ~0.55 and is not broken, but after gain drop to ~0.6 the estimator drives ff from ~0.28 to ~0.50-0.55. Loop gain preserved by scale=(1.15/Kest) in [0.8,1.9] applied to KP0=1.1/KI0=0.020, I limits widened to [-0.20,0.50] and UMAX 0.85 so degraded hold ~0.53 is reachable without windup. Filter/outlier, slew limit and y>0.75 shutoff retained for noise and safety.

extra.machine_card: First-order heater + loss to room, y in [0,1] (0.15C=0.15, 0.75C=1). Pre: AMB~0.17, tau~150-220s, delay ~15-20s, K~1.15, u_ss(0.5)~0.28. Post: AMB~0.16-0.17, tau~140-170s, delay ~15-20s, noise same, K~0.59-0.67 (~0.55x), u_ss(0.5)~0.53-0.58. No delay increase, no extra loss, no sensor shift.
extra.predicted_behavior: Nominal: ff~0.28, Kest~1.15, rise in ~120-180s, MAE ~0.006-0.008, in-band >0.94, u_mean ~0.28, zero overrides. Degraded (K~0.6): settled detector raises Kest to ~0.60-0.68 within ~150-250s, ff to ~0.49-0.55, scheduled KP~2.0/KI~0.038 plus integrator trims residual, y returns to 0.5 band, MAE ~0.010-0.013, in-band ~0.86-0.97, u_mean ~0.42-0.45, zero hard violations/overrides.
